project: Spatial transcriptome and epitranscriptome: spatial imputation

mask_semantics.gt_ratio: finite on observed_mask, NaN outside observed_mask
mask_semantics.train_ratio: finite on train_mask, NaN outside train_mask
mask_semantics.pred_ratio: finite on train_mask and val_mask; train_mask is overwritten with GT; unobserved entries may be finite predictions or NaN

seed_semantics.model_seed: controls model initialization, training randomness, inner masking, and diffusion sampling
seed_semantics.prediction_level_ensemble: requires one fixed mask_seed and multiple model_seeds
